bibl.title: Les graffiti démotiques du domaine d'Amon à Karnak: des chiffres et des lettres.
bibl.seg: Ghislaine Widmer, Les graffiti démotiques du domaine d'Amon à Karnak: des chiffres et des lettres.
Bulletin de la Société française d'Égyptologie 201 (avril 2019) pp. 104-120, figg.
bibl.note: A closer look at the walls of the Karnak temples reveals in various places traces of a more personal form of relationship with the gods. Here, demotic graffiti, often less elaborate than their hieroglyphic or hieratic counterparts, hold a special place, both in terms of when they were written and the, at times, rather unusual nature of their contents. The focus is on two or three specific inscriptions. These include a very targeted case of damnatio memoriae and a series of numbers carved in stone which turn out to be calculations but whose purpose remains uncertain. Provides an opportunity to revisit a group of Coptic texts incised on the girdle wall of Thutmose III, in the round corridor near the Akhmenu.
